 By Sneha Kulkarni , ET Online Last Updated: Oct 21, 2026, 09:44:00 AM IST Follow us Share Font Size Abc Small Abc Medium Abc Large Save Print Comment Synopsis
 Bank holiday today: Bank branches will be closed on October 21, 2026, in several Indian states for Vijaya Dasami festivals. Customers are advised to check the Reserve Bank of India's holiday list before their visits. Digital banking services such as mobile banking and UPI will remain available on this holiday. Listen to this article in summarized format
 Listen ET Online ​Are banks open or closed in your state today?​ Bank customers in many states must plan their branch visits accordingly as banks will remain closed on Wednesday, October 21, 2026, on account of Vijaya Dasami, Durga Puja and Maha Dashami. If you need to visit a bank branch in these states, check the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) holiday list before heading out.
 Are banks open or closed in your state today (October 21, 2026)?
Banks in Sikkim, Tripura, Karnataka, Assam, Kerala, West Bengal and Meghalaya will be closed on October 21, 2026, to celebrate Dussehra/Vijaya Dasami/Durga Puja (Dasain)/Maha Dashami.
In India, all scheduled and non-scheduled banks observe public holidays on the second and fourth Saturdays. The first, third and fifth (in some cases) are a working Saturday for banks unless specified in the RBI holiday calendar.

 Bank holidays in October 2026
Mahatma Gandhi Jayanti, Mahalaya Amavasya, Maha Saptami, Dussehra (Mahashtami)/Maha Navami/Ayutha Pooja/Durga Puja/Vijaya Dashomi/Durga Ashtami, Dasara/Dusshera (Vijaya Dashmi) (Aaso sud-10)/Mahanavami, Ayudhapooja/Durga Puja, Vijaya Dasami/Durga Puja (Dasain), Durga Puja (Dasain), Laxmi Puja/Accession Day/Maharishi Valmiki’s birthday, Karva Chauth and Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel’s birthday.
 Digital banking will be available on holidays
Even though bank branches will remain closed in a few states today, customers can use mobile banking, internet banking and the Unified Payments Interface (UPI) for their banking needs, as these services are generally available on holidays.
